SELECT cp.id AS project_id, cp.serial_number AS project_serial_number, cp.short_name AS project_short_name, cp.structure_status AS structure_type, cp.structure_area AS contract_weight, IFNULL(tcw.deepen_weight, 0) AS deepen_weight, IFNULL(tpw.produced_weight, 0) AS produced_weight, IFNULL((tcw.deepen_weight - tpw.produced_weight), 0) AS not_produced_weight, IFNULL(tsw.scheduling_weight, 0) AS scheduling_weight, IFNULL(tdw.delivery_weight, 0) AS delivery_weight FROM contract_project AS cp LEFT JOIN contract_tech ct ON ct.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ct.category_type = 2 AND ct.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.project_id, (SUM(ta.total_net_weight) / 1000) AS deepen_weight FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE GROUP BY ta.project_id ) tcw ON tcw.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.project_id, (SUM(ta.produced_quantity * net_weight) / 1000) AS produced_weight FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE GROUP BY ta.project_id ) tpw ON tpw.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mbt.project_id, (SUM(mbt.task_quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000) AS scheduling_weight FROM mes_building_task mbt LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = mbt.product_id WHERE mbt.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbt.task_type_enum = 2 GROUP BY mbt.project_id ) tsw ON tsw.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mbws.project_id, (SUM(mbws.quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000) AS delivery_weight FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary mbws LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = mbws.product_id WHERE mbws.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbws.type = 2 AND mbws.product_type = 2 GROUP BY mbws.project_id ) tdw ON tdw.project_id = cp.id WHERE cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
#{i}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ta.total_net_weight) / 1000, 0) FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT #{projectId} AS project_id, t.monomer_id, t.area_id, IFNULL(t.weight, 0) as weight, pm.name AS monomer_name, pa.name AS area_name FROM ( SELECT ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id, (SUM(ta.total_net_weight) / 1000) AS weight FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id ) t LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pm.id = t.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa ON pa.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pa.id = t.area_id

SELECT pa.project_id, pa.monomer_id, pa.id AS area_id, pm.name AS monomer_name, pa.name AS area_name, IFNULL(completeValume.weight, 0) AS weight, IFNULL(deepen.total_weight, 0) AS total_weight FROM plan_area pa LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pm.id = pa.monomer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id, (SUM(ta.total_net_weight) / 1000) AS total_weight FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id ) deepen ON deepen.monomer_id = pa.monomer_id AND deepen.area_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mbt.monomer_id, mbt.area_id, (SUM(mbt.task_quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000) AS weight FROM mes_building_task mbt LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = mbt.product_id WHERE mbt.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbt.task_type_enum = 2 AND mbt.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY mbt.monomer_id, mbt.area_id ) completeValume ON completeValume.monomer_id = pa.monomer_id AND completeValume.area_id = pa.id WHERE pa.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pa.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT pa.project_id, pa.monomer_id, pa.id AS area_id, pm.name AS monomer_name, pa.name AS area_name, IFNULL(completeValume.weight, 0) AS weight, IFNULL(deepen.total_weight, 0) AS total_weight FROM plan_area pa LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pm.id = pa.monomer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id, (SUM(ta.total_net_weight) / 1000) AS total_weight FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id ) deepen ON deepen.monomer_id = pa.monomer_id AND deepen.area_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id, (SUM(ta.produced_quantity * net_weight) / 1000) AS weight FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id ) completeValume ON completeValume.monomer_id = pa.monomer_id AND completeValume.area_id = pa.id WHERE pa.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pa.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT pa.project_id, pa.monomer_id, pa.id AS area_id, pm.name AS monomer_name, pa.name AS area_name, IFNULL(completeValume.weight, 0) AS weight, IFNULL(deepen.total_weight, 0) AS total_weight FROM plan_area pa LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pm.id = pa.monomer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id, (SUM(ta.total_net_weight) / 1000) AS total_weight FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id ) deepen ON deepen.monomer_id = pa.monomer_id AND deepen.area_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id, (SUM((ta.quantity - ta.produced_quantity) * net_weight) / 1000) AS weight FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id ) completeValume ON completeValume.monomer_id = pa.monomer_id AND completeValume.area_id = pa.id WHERE pa.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pa.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT pa.project_id, pa.monomer_id, pa.id AS area_id, pm.name AS monomer_name, pa.name AS area_name, IFNULL(completeValume.weight, 0) AS weight, IFNULL(deepen.total_weight, 0) AS total_weight FROM plan_area pa LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pm.id = pa.monomer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id, (SUM(ta.total_net_weight) / 1000) AS total_weight FROM tech_artifact ta WHERE ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY ta.monomer_id, ta.area_id ) deepen ON deepen.monomer_id = pa.monomer_id AND deepen.area_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mbws.monomer_id, mbws.area_id, (SUM(mbws.quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000) AS weight FROM mes_building_warehouse_summary mbws LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = mbws.product_id WHERE mbws.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbws.type = 2 AND mbws.product_type = 2 AND mbws.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY mbws.monomer_id, mbws.area_id ) completeValume ON completeValume.monomer_id = pa.monomer_id AND completeValume.area_id = pa.id WHERE pa.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pa.project_id = #{projectId}
